scientific_integrity: Original theorem with explicit algebraic proof; the standalone exact-arithmetic checker corroborates finitely many instances only.
scientific_limitations: Finite totally ordered state spaces; stochastic monotonicity; one-step row-stochastic matrices. Sharp examples not constrained to be reversible. No theorem about general partial orders or time-homogeneous mixing. Historical priority assessed from inspected sources but not independently certified.
title: Sharp variation–Dobrushin separation for stochastically monotone Markov operators
